_note: v7.1.0 — registers the Stop event hook so run-log.jsonl receives a summary line on every session end (including crashes). See .claude/hooks/stop-hook.cjs for SOFT-fail contract; the hook never exits non-zero. The handler reads sentinel-state.json + session.json from the most recently updated pipeline run folder and appends the 12 REQUIRED_FIELDS via lib/run-log.cjs::appendRunLog.
